messages:
mira: Quick note — the embeddings+rerrank sampleapp (Python) is unstable on async flows. Sync rerank returns a list of objects but the async batch helper currently yields a dict-of-arrays shape and unpredictable ordering. Breaking our typed postprocess in examples.

mira: Example (sync expected):
```python
out = client.rerank(items)
# out == [ {'id':'doc1','score':0.87}, {'id':'doc2','score':0.42} ]
```

mira: Example (async problematic):
```python
out = await client.rerank_batch(items)
# out == {'ids': ['doc2','doc1'], 'scores': [0.42,0.87]}  # nested + shuffled
```

mira: Also seeing auth weirdness: if the app supplies an async token-refresh callback, the async client sometimes retries 401 using the stale token because the retry path doesn't await the refresh callback. Silent and nasty for users.

jchen: Confirmed. Two distinct problems: (A) response shape parity between legacy rerank and new vector-unified endpoints, and (B) async batcher appending results in arrival-order rather than input-order when sub-batches finish at different times.

jchen: Repro: set batch_size=2, items = [q1,q2,q3], run async path — results may be out of order.

sam: Proposal: unify SDK to always emit List[TypedHit] (pydantic) from rerank endpoints. Add an adapter to convert dict-of-arrays -> list-of-objects using index alignment. Also add preserve_order flag to batch helper.

sam: For API ergonomics: `await batcher.map(items, preserve_order=True)` (default preserve_order=False to keep existing perf semantics). Implementation: keep (item, idx) pairs, gather, then sort by idx and return.

ashley: On auth: our AuthProvider accepts sync or async callbacks but async code currently does `token = auth_cb()` and doesn't await. Fix: detect inspect.isawaitable and await, and make sure retry logic fetches a fresh token before retrying. I'll draft a small change.

ashley: Snippet for auth shim:
```python
maybe = auth_cb()
if inspect.isawaitable(maybe):
    token = await maybe
else:
    token = maybe
headers['Authorization'] = f"Bearer {token}"
```
I'll include unit tests for both sync and async callbacks and for 401->refresh->retry flow.

ms: (mira) File hints: examples/embeddings_rerank/sampleapp.py, sdk/python/redwood/client/_async_batcher.py, sdk/python/redwood/auth/provider.py.

jchen: Creating tickets: RDX-4501 (rerank response parity), RDX-4502 (async batch ordering/preserve_order), RDX-4503 (awaitable auth callback + retry). Will attach repros.

sam: I'll add RerankHit pydantic model (id, score, metadata?) and a normalize_rerank_response() helper to keep sampleapps simple while we migrate. Adapter accepts both shapes.

qa-bot: queued a small e2e job that runs the examples against the mock reranker in CI; will surface regressions.

mira: For short-term unblock I pushed a tiny sampleapp patch that normalizes responses client-side. Will revert when SDK fixes land.

ashley: I'll open PRs: one for auth awaitable handling + tests, one for batcher preserve_order and ordering tests. @mira please review auth PR.

sam: I'll do the typed model + adapter PR and add docs snippet showing unified JSON for rerank.

mira: Thanks — once merged let's add an integration job to CI matrix (sync/async x py3.10/3.11) so onboarding doesn't break again. Closing thread after tickets and PRs are linked.
